    • Deviprasad
      1 out of 5 stars
      Very Disappointing Experience – New Laptop with Multiple Issues
      Reviewed in India on 14 October 2026
      Size: 6GB RTX 3050, 12GB DDR5Configuration: Without HP Care
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I purchased this HP Victus laptop on 14 October 2026 through Amazon, expecting a brand-new product in perfect condition. Unfortunately, my experience has been extremely disappointing.

      Warranty Already Started: The laptop warranty had already started on 24 April 2026, several months before my purchase. This raises serious concerns about the product's warranty status and whether it was properly registered as a new unit.

      Charger Overheating: The charger becomes excessively hot during charging, which is concerning for a newly purchased laptop.

      Poor Sound Quality: The audio quality is disappointing, and the sound output does not meet my expectations.

      Lack of Quality Assurance: These issues raise concerns about the quality checks performed before the product was sold.

      Poor First Impression: A newly purchased laptop should not come with warranty discrepancies and concerns about its accessories and performance.

      Loss of Trust: I paid a significant amount for a new laptop, but instead of enjoying my purchase, I am worried about its condition, reliability and long-term performance.

      Customer Satisfaction: Customers who pay for a brand-new product deserve a properly documented warranty, reliable accessories and satisfactory performance from day one.
